newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Sun Air shortlist news delayed.
newsitem.headline: S.African Sun Air shortlist news delayed.

text.p: The names of shortlisted parties for the upcoming privatisation of domestic carrier Sun Air will not be announced on Friday as originally scheduled, a Transport Ministry spokesperson said on Thursday.

"The process is taking longer than expected and the names will not be announced this week," the spokesperson told Reuters, adding that more time was needed to thoroughly investigate non-binding bids received last week.
South Africa's Ministry for Public Enterprise and Transport said last week it had received four non-binding bids for the sale of the airline.
These include the Malaysia Airlines Consortium, the Virgin Atlantic Bhekilanga Consortium, the Comair Consortium and the Phoenix Venture Partners Consortium.
It said at the time that a shortlist would be announced on May 30 and groups shortlisted would be given an opportunity to perform due diligence investigations before submitting binding bids.
Analysts have speculated that the sale of Sun Air could fetch around 100 million rand.

Public Enterprises Minister Stella Sigcau has said no final decision had been taken on how to use the proceeds of the full privatisation of Sun Air, the second major sell-off by the government following the sale of a 30 percent stake in telecommunications utility Telkom earlier this year.
Sun Air operates eight aircraft on routes between Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
